routes.name: Residence permit on a self-employment permit

note: Bulgaria, read on 2026-10-31 in the European Commission's EU Immigration Portal (Directorate-General for Migration and Home Affairs), its pages 'Employed worker in Bulgaria' and 'Self-employed worker in Bulgaria', both dated 1 April 2025 (secondary: the Commission's summary of the Law on Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria, whose consolidated text on lex.bg answered with a Cloudflare check and wasn't read). The single permit is applied for after an approval the employer obtains from the Employment Agency (with a labour market test, from which an actor-performer approved by the Ministry of Culture is exempt), on a type D visa, and obtained from the Migration Directorate once in Bulgaria; it gives the right to reside and to work at the employer named, and is tied to the employer and position (work: sponsor). The Commission's pages give it at most one year, renewable up to three; the Migration Directorate's own procedure for the single permit (Ministry of Interior, its 2021 document, linked from its site and read 2026-11-03) issues it for three years, or for the work contract's length where that is shorter, so the term written was one year until 2026-11-03 and is three since. That procedure has the foreigner appear at the Directorate within 14 days of entering on the D visa, the permit issued within three days of that, and the whole procedure lasting at most two months, or four where it is complex (no decision time is written, the longest depending on the case); it exempts from the labour market test performing artists with proven professional competence once the Ministry of Culture confirms the interest in hiring them. A self-employed person holds a self-employment permit (at most one year, renewable up to three) and a residence permit from the Migration Directorate after entering, whose term is aligned with it; the work it allows isn't stated beyond the activity planned, so it isn't written. Long-term (permanent) residence may be asked for after five years of legal residence, at the Migration Directorate or a Bulgarian embassy or consulate (the employed worker's page names only the Directorate); its holder needs no work permit (work: any). The pages call it 'long-term residence' on one and 'permanent residence' on the other; the Law's own terms (продължително, постоянно, дългосрочно пребиваващ в ЕС) weren't read. No fee or decision time is given. EU, EEA and Swiss citizens' free movement isn't on these pages and isn't written here.

sources.title: European Commission, EU Immigration Portal: Employed worker in Bulgaria (1 April 2025)
sources.said: Once you have arrived in Bulgaria with your valid visa (in case you need a visa to enter the country), you must also obtain a Single permit itself from the Migration Directorate . Your Single permit gives you the right to reside in Bulgaria and work at the respective employer’s enterprise in Bulgaria. ... The Single permit is valid for a maximum of one year, renewable for a maximum of up to three years. ... Single/Work permits are issued to a specific employee and to the specific position and type of work. Change is not allowed. ... an actor-performer, approved by the Ministry of Culture; ... You will be eligible for long-term residence status after five years of legal residence. ... As a long-term resident, you will not need a single/work permit and will have equal access to health insurance and social security.

sources.title: European Commission, EU Immigration Portal: Self-employed worker in Bulgaria (1 April 2025)
sources.said: you must also obtain a residence permit from the Migration Directorate after you enter Bulgaria ... The Self-employment Permit is valid for a maximum of one year, renewable for a maximum of up to three years. ... The duration of the residence permit is aligned with the Self-employment permit. ... You will be eligible for permanent residence status after five years of legal residence. ... Applications for permanent residence must be submitted to the Migration Directorate of the Ministry of Interior, or to the Bulgarian embassy or consulate in your home country . ... As a permanent resident, you will not need a work permit

sources.title: Ministry of Interior, Migration Directorate, Процедура_Единно разрешение за пребиваване и работа_2021 (DOCX, linked from mvr.bg/migration, 'Разрешения за пребиваване и работа')
sources.said: ЕРПР се издава за срок от три години, а когато срокът на трудовия договор е по-кратък от три години, разрешението се издава за срока на продължителността на договора. ... Артисти-изпълнители по смисъла на чл. 74 от Закона за авторското право и сродните му права с доказана професионална компетентност – след потвърден от Министерството на културата интерес от наемането им; ... 11. В 14-дневен срок от влизането на територията на Република България с виза по чл. 15, ал. 1 от ЗЧРБ, чужденецът се явява лично в дирекция "Миграция" ... издава или отказва издаването на разрешение за продължително пребиваване и работа тип "Единно разрешение за пребиваване и работа" в срок до три дни от представянето на документите по т.11. ... Процедурата по издаване на разрешение за продължително пребиваване и работа тип "Единно разрешение за пребиваване и работа" не може да бъде по-дълга от два месеца, като при фактическа и правна сложност този срок може да бъде продължен с два месеца.
